description: Price and how to buy a dated evidence pack over x402 (USDC on Base, 1 to 30 cents). About one period: edition (the depth file behind a final State of Agent Money edition: every agent and every payee of the period, the edition's figures and the period's book; id = YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn or latest; 30 cents). About one agent: precheck (the routine check before you pay or hire it: level, last payment, live incidents, statement freshness, and with payto what that address is), liveness, paygraph (where it pays), drain, incidents, peer, builders (which apps build its transactions, ERC-8021), exit (did its wallet empty out: every window in which a new payee took most of its outflow in 72 hours, with where the money went next; candidates, never verdicts), trace (where did the money go: its exits followed live up to three hops, with each hop's issuer freeze, swap out of a freezable token and Tron activity), bundle, reval (a live re-probe) or statement (its last 24 statements with proofs). About one address: counterparty (which ranked agents paid it) or venue (what the address is: label, contract or key, who pays it, poisoning look-alike or not, live 48-hour flow). This tool does not pay; an x402-capable client fetches the returned URL, receives HTTP 402 with the exact price, and retries with a signed payment.

id.description: Agent token id, slug or wallet; for counterparty and venue, the 0x address

payto.description: precheck only, optional: the 0x address you are about to pay
